scope: Bounded, read-only ATX 12V bottom-loop bar assessment; no source/board edits or procurement. Three shortlisted part families, two additional deliberate native rejection screens, no search sweep.

native_source.header_note: No J6P/J6C/J6D pad carries /SENSE12V_HI. J6P carries +5V_SYS_PORT and GND. A direct header bypass is not this source-to-RS1 current path.

shortlist.manufacturer_evidence: 20A; MJP-1.0 copper (shorter MJP variants are phosphor bronze); tin over nickel. Nominal total height2.3mm, underside1.8mm, width1.8mm, total length26.8mm. Recommended >=2x2mm lands at25.4mm centres.
shortlist.availability_note: Distributor page says manufacturer order/no store stock; indexed delivery date not relied on. No global JLC assembly availability or fee verified.
shortlist.status: No legal demonstrated bottom-loop layout; direct and remote native trials below reject. B.Cu outward mounting lacks unchanged-Z proof. F.Cu trial near input band hits existing keepout/foreign 5V copper.
indispensable_vendor_evidence: Guaranteed minimum assembled underside and maximum assembled height including component, solder and seating tolerances
Current/temperature-rise test conditions and acceptable solder land/process for15A design path
Actual quote/stock and assembly route/fees if subsequently a legal placement is demonstrated

shortlist.manufacturer_verified: Copper, silver plated, SMT,12.3mm overall length. Manufacturer drawing endpoint accessible to web viewer but no readable text; not newly visually dimension-qualified in this assessment.
shortlist.status: Cheap lower-height short link, not a demonstrated replacement for the >=16.15mm lateral excursion from left12V trunk x2.2 to J3.11 x18.35. Do not chain parts or assume current sharing. No native placement trial because source geometry/underside/current guarantee not established.
indispensable_vendor_evidence: Readable manufacturer drawing specifying land centres, guaranteed height/underside and tolerances
Manufacturer15A-or-higher current rating with thermal/assembly context
A legal new rated connection topology; lower nominal height alone does not remove J3 tail interference or prove unchanged complete Z

shortlist.source_evidence: Solid copper, tin over nickel, THT only, arch for jumping components. Supplier catalog names40-57A, linked ampacity page39-76A: contextual ratings, not automatic whole-board qualification. Prior visually reviewed drawing .565in length,.240in width,.494in total height,.125in penetration: nominal installed apex9.373mm above PCB; two1.4224x6.985mm slots on13.081mm centres.
shortlist.status: Inexpensive actual THT bridge, but large slots and arch are not drop-in J3 pad geometry. Outward arch would increase Z; inward arch is potentially below22mm gap but conflicts with16mm J3 housing if crossing its footprint. Remote placement requires new slots/routing and full paired geometry. No demonstrated benefit over no-bar12V reroute.
indispensable_vendor_evidence: Guaranteed component/installed height, slot/lead tolerances and underside profile at all crossing coordinates
Application-relevant current/temperature-rise basis and hole/barrel/solder process
No-increase complete-Z proof including outward tails and solder after any inward installation

complete_z_boundary.warning: A2.6mm possible tail maximum is not a guaranteed existing stand-off floor. It cannot prove a2.3mm nominal outward MJP adds no complete Z, and maximum tails may exceed nominal1.8mm MJP underside. No automatic trimming or clearance credit.

bounded_exclusions: Mac8 MJ low-profile family is7A per manufacturer https://www.mac8japan.com/products/333 and is not eligible for15A. No parallel sharing assumption. No open-ended catalog search performed.
decision: No source-qualified part-plus-layout presently warrants purchase or bar investment for this bottleneck. Prioritize root's bounded no-bar J3 shift/12V loop reroute proof. If that fails for a specifically documented crossing, retain MJP only as a conditional inward-face candidate after legal new lands/rated stubs and guaranteed height/process evidence; do not claim all possible placements are impossible.
